Hospital Admitted Patient Care and 
Adult Critical Care Activity: Summary table - 2024-25

This publication describes NHS-funded inpatient, day case and adult critical care activity in England.

The data source for this publication is Hospital Episode Statistics (HES).

This file provides some high level analyses of HES Admitted Patient Care data relating to finished consultant episodes (FCEs) and finished admission episodes (FAEs) and Adult Critical Care records in NHS hospitals and for NHS funded activity in the independent sector. This document provides data tables to supplement the summary report.

The ICB of responsibility table contains episodes grouped according to the responsible Integrated Care Board (ICB). This does not necessarily reflect where the patient lived or where they were treated (see the hospital providers table). Clinical Commission Groups transitioned to Integrated Care Boards in July 2022 - this file can be used as the previous CCG of responsibly in previous releases. ICBs/CCGs took responsibility for commissioning secondary care in April 2013.
